text:
ingrid: FYI — multiple customers reporting increased 502/504s against /v1/generate since the 00:15 staged rollout. Tickets 9872 / 9873 / 9876.

sre-oncall: Ack, looking. Any pattern on regions or models?

ingrid: Mostly eu-west-1 and us-east-1, spans models rdx-small and rdx-medium. Latency for passing requests seems normal, but failure rate jumped ~3x.

kevin: Rolling config change at 00:10 to traffic-split policy + header-enforcement flag. Could be the header trim. I pushed the change. @deploy-bot show rollout diff.

deploy-bot: rollout-id=rl-2026-03-17-007
changed: routing.policy: "traffic-split: 85/15" -> "90/10"
changed: api.ingress.auth_strip: false -> true

amanda: If auth_strip turned on, older clients might send multi-value Authorization headers that get truncated -> downstream 502 from edge. Repro attempt: curl with both auth headers.

sam: Running quick repro against the canary variant (90% variant A).

sam: Running:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer validtoken" -H "Authorization: Basic abc" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

sam: Getting 502 with upstream: "bad request: invalid auth format" in the gateway logs.

kevin: That matches hypothesis. The header sanitizer change was meant to drop duplicate headers, but our parser rejects multi-value combos. Should have feature gated.

sre-oncall: Can we revert the single config flag quickly? We need rollback plan and coordination with support.

ingrid: Support is starting outbound comms. Customers asking for ETA.

kevin: I can flip `api.ingress.auth_strip` back to `false` on the rollout controller. Doing a targeted rollback to 00:14 state for the staged rollout.

kevin: Executing:
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback rl-2026-03-17-007 --to=rl-2026-03-17-006 --scope=staged
```

kevin: Done. Controller reports success, new rollout id rl-2026-03-17-008.

sre-oncall: Observability — error rate dropping?

sre-oncall: (1m) 502s peaked at 3.4% -> 0.6% after rollback. Latency stable.

support-bot: Open tickets updated: 9872 state=investigating->mitigated, 9873->mitigated, 9876->mitigated.

ingrid: I'm telling customers we mitigated and collecting logs for RCA. Need blameless postmortem and a guard for header parser changes.

amanda: Action items: 1) revert in prod (done), 2) add automated e2e with multi-value Authorization header against ingress, 3) add rollout guard to block auth_strip flips without full release, 4) postmortem in #postmortems.

sam: I'll attach the failing gateway log snippet and the minimal repro curl in the ticket. Gateway log:
```
[2026-03-17T00:18:22Z] gw: request_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate status=502 err="invalid auth format: multiple values" upstream_status=400
```

kevin: Addendum: We didn't hit the shedder, requests were forwarded and rejected by parser, so no overload, just bad parsing path.

sre-oncall: Monitoring/alerts: temporarily raised alert threshold to avoid noisy paging while we stabilize, but kept critical pages for >5% sustained 5xx.

ingrid: Thanks all. I'll coordinate follow-up with customers and postmortem owner. Closing thread when postmortem link is up. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Postmortem owner: kevin. Tentative writeup ETA EOD.

support-bot: Incident resolved marker added.
